-- monthly credit card spend per month per merchant category
SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.full_name,
    date_trunc('month', t.created_at)::date               AS month,
    m.category                                            AS merchant_category,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.amount < 0 THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_spend,
    COUNT(*)                                              AS num_transactions
FROM customers c
JOIN accounts a       ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN transactions t   ON t.account_id = a.account_id
suggested_completion:

WHERE t.transaction_type = 'card'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name, month, m.category
ORDER BY c.customer_id, month, total_spend DESC;

--Give me a 360° customer summary showing PII (name, email, city, state), number of accounts, total balances, number of transactions, and their most recent transaction date. Sort by total balance descending.
SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.full_name,
    c.email,
    c.city,
    c.state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)                                   AS num_accounts,
    SUM(a.current_balance)                                         AS total_current_balance,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.transaction_id)                               AS num_transactions,
    MAX(t.created_at)                                              AS last_transaction_at
suggested_completion:
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN accounts a
    ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN transactions t
    ON t.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY
    c.customer_id,
    c.full_name,
    c.email,
    c.city,
    c.state
ORDER BY
    total_current_balance DESC;
